text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking in front of the station on an errand,
a familiar uniform caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, she turns down a deserted alleyway.
Curious, I follow after her――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey. What's the idea, sneaking around following me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Depending on your answer... I might have a plan of my own.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that I hadn't been tailing her—I was just worried
because she was heading into such a secluded spot.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hmph, you're quite an odd duck, looking after someone who isn't even your trainee.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry, I'm just grabbing a bite to eat.
I've got a couple of regular spots tucked away in the back alleys.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: They're all tiny joints, but the food is cheap and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Though, I can't make up my mind. Offal stew or
curry... which one should I go for today...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're a beef offal stew fan? Rare choice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: A lot of people dislike it because of the distinct taste, so why'd you pick it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Appreciating subtle flavors, are you...? It seems we share good taste.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The trendy grub they serve at the academy
ain't half bad, but――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Some days, all you want is the comforting warmth of plain brown broth infused with savory offal and the natural sweetness of vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, there was a place at one of the racetracks that served amazing offal stew.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll stop by next time... Whatever.
Trainer, you head on back to your nest already.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Katsu" curry, huh... Eating it for victory and good luck?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Not like there's any Buddha out there gonna save ya just 'cause ya wear a charm.
...Still, reachin' out for anything to cling to—guess that's human nature.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're right. Guess I'll borrow a little of your good fortune today.
choice_data_list: The academy has katsu curry too, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I'm in the mood to eat alone today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I eat around campus, busybodies
like you won't stop pestering me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
In that regard, at a back-alley shop,
all you gotta do is order and keep your mouth shut.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, though sometimes she silently meddles
by dishing out extra-large portions without asking...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, one of the racetracks had
a popular curry place that served huge portions.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll stop by next time... Whatever.
Trainer, you head on back to your nest already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With those words, Nakayama Festa melted away
into the dark alleyway without once looking back.
